title: The Zoom That Moved the Point: Zooming About the Cursor, Panning in Pixels and Stopping at the Data

questions.question: A chart is zoomed by 2 about its middle, and the cursor was on time 80 of 0 to 100. Where is the cursor point now?
options: Off the right edge: x = 1100 of 1000
questions.explanation: Zooming about the cursor is what keeps it at 800.

questions.question: What does zoom_about keep fixed?
options: The anchor, at the same fraction of the window
questions.explanation: 216 zooms did not move the anchor.

questions.question: Why is 1.12 in and 0.88 out wrong for a wheel?
options: Their product is 0.9856, so a turn out does not undo a turn in
questions.explanation: Five each left the width at 107.5 where it began at 100.

questions.question: What is one notch of the wheel in Qt units?
Dragging 100 pixels right on a 1000 pixel chart of 0 to 100. What is the window?
options: -10 to 90: the window moves the other way
questions.explanation: The data follows the hand, so the window goes the other way.

questions.question: A window is pushed past the start of the data. What does clamp_to do?
options: Moves it back to the start, keeping its width
